title: Concept: Meta referrer tag sends full URLs to every destination
description: unsafe-url in a meta referrer element sends the full page URL, path and query to every destination, including plaintext origins. Tokens, invitation keys and user identifiers commonly sit in the query string, so a single outbound link or image can move them to a third party log.
applicability: Responses whose page content sets a referrer policy through a meta element.
risk: Sensitive query parameters are disclosed to third parties and to plaintext destinations through the Referer header of every outbound request.
